NORTH WESTERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Notification made by the Governor of North Western Province

Amara Piyaseeli Rathnayaka being the Governor of the North Western Province in terms of power vested in me underSub-section (4) and (5) of Section 154(f) of Amendment Act, No. 13 of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republicof Sri Lanka, do hereby proclaim that New Mini Cabinet of the North Western Province was sworn in/affirmed before me atColombo on this 14th September, 2015 on the following posts in terms of Section 165 and Section 157(a)7 of the Constitutionof Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka.
Proclaimed at Kurunegala on this Forteenth day in September of Two Thousand Fifteen.
AMARA PIYASEELI RATHNAYAKA, The Governor of the North Western Province.
